dashboard.label: TA-memwatch Overview
dashboard.description: Collects early-warning memory signals from /proc/meminfo, /proc/vmstat and /proc/slabinfo: available-memory percentage, swap usage, cumulative swap-in/out counters, cumulative

search.query: index=main sourcetype="memwatch:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="memwatch.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="memwatch:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
